title: Integrating AI in Business Central: A Step-by-Step Guide
summary: Step-by-step guide to building a custom AI-powered Copilot agent in Business Central that automates customer address extraction from unstructured text using Azure OpenAI. Covers Azure setup, AL code development including isolated storage for secrets, prompt engineering with system and user prompts, and integration with the Customer card.
key_points: Azure OpenAI resources and credentials (endpoint, deployment, API key) must be securely stored in Isolated Storage to protect sensitive authentication data
Copilot capabilities must be registered during extension installation and added to the Copilot & agent capabilities management page
System prompts define AI behavior and expected output format (JSON recommended), while user prompts provide the actual data to process
Chat completion parameters like max tokens, temperature (0 for deterministic results), and JSON mode control response quality and cost
Retry logic with up to 5 attempts handles cases where the AI may not respond successfully on the first try

quotes.text: Business Central has something called Isolated Storage. This is storage that is only accessible to the extension that created it.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the recommended secure storage mechanism for secrets and authentication credentials in Business Central extensions

quotes.text: If we wanted to describe something, we would use a higher number to allow for more creative expressions. The max value is 2.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies how temperature parameter controls AI creativity and determinism, essential for tuning response quality
